data.name: Emulate Melee Weapon
data.description: You can form your mind blade to replicate any single melee weapon, chosen at the time you take this blade skill.  You are proficient with your mind blade in this form and it functions in all ways as the chosen weapon.  This blade skill may not be used with the mind bolt.
